title: Penalty.
bodyText: Any person, firm, company, association, or corporation committing any unfair or deceptive practice as defined in section 445-95.2 shall be fined $500 for each violation.
bodyHtml: [§445-95.4]  Penalty.  Any person, firm, company, association, or corporation committing any unfair or deceptive practice as defined in section 445-95.2 shall be fined $500 for each violation. [L 1988, c 313, pt of §3]
